text: Yes, the 2022 tree-cover loss claim was corroborated by independent reference data. Hansen/UMD detected a loss of 0.6 ha (3.41% of the asset) in 2022, which meets the minimum event size (0.5 ha). The JRC 2020 forest reference map agreed with 100% of the event area, and a later observation (2025) confirmed persistence. The MGAP 2021 forest map classified 83% (0.5 ha) of the loss area as native forest. While this confirms the loss occurred, it does not specify the cause or legality.
